title: About
text: My name is Michael Tatten, and I am a Sports Media and Communications and Broadcasting student at the University of Nebraska–Lincoln. I have a strong passion for sports, journalism, broadcasting, and digital media. I enjoy storytelling, creating engaging content, and finding new ways to connect with audiences through media. I am driven, creative, and always looking for opportunities to learn, develop new skills, and challenge myself. My goal is to build a career in the sports and media industry while continuing to grow as a communicator, storyteller, and content creator.
